live_frontier_title: beta-map shift covariance / cross-depth mismatch summability audit
current_determination: R71 proves abstractly that cross-depth marginal-tail coherence follows from common endpoint normalization, backward uniqueness of the scalar one-step maps, and exact shift covariance of those maps under (N,j)->(N+1,j+1). R70 already closed physical-scale alignment and R61 supplied the abstract uniqueness grammar, so the scalar branch is reduced to NativeBetaMapShiftCovariance. CMP119 source-attests the localized recursion and phi_j=1 on the interior, which removes the cutoff function from the bulk cocycle; any phi/domain mismatch near boundaries is retyped into the boundary/B sector. The current source corpus does not establish beta_(j+1)^(N+1)=beta_j^(N) exactly. Secondary reference [85] v2 gives structural evidence for a scale-homogeneous leading flow g_(k+1)^-2 = g_k^-2 + 2 b0 log L + O(g_k^2), but remains a locator rather than primary custody. Exact tail equality is stronger than necessary: a summable beta-map shift defect plus inverse-map stability would suffice as a fallback.
major_new_results: CrossDepthMarginalTailCoherence is reduced algebraically to NativeBetaMapShiftCovariance once endpoint and backward uniqueness are fixed.
Bulk phi_j localization drops out because CMP119 has phi_j=1 on the common interior.
Boundary/localized coupling mismatches are retyped into the B/boundary sector rather than the bulk marginal coordinate.
Endpoint equality plus scale alignment alone does not imply tail coherence.
SummableMarginalTailMismatch is identified as a weaker sufficient fallback to exact tail equality.
negative_results: Do not infer exact beta-map shift covariance from suppressed N-dependence in source notation.
Do not promote the secondary 2 b0 log L + O(g^2) formula to an exact cocycle theorem.
Do not mix boundary phi_j/domain effects into the bulk scalar recursion.
Do not require exact tail equality when a summable scalar mismatch would suffice for fixed-observable convergence.
Do not infer continuum Yang-Mills existence or a mass gap from scalar cocycle closure.
live_obligations: Extract which parameters enter the native Paper-I beta_j map besides g and fixed L.
Test parameter invariance under the aligned cross-depth index shift.
Determine whether finite-volume/domain effects break exact bulk beta-map covariance or only produce boundary-localized corrections.
If exact equality is unavailable, bound the beta-map shift defect and prove summable marginal-tail mismatch using inverse-map stability.
Keep PrimaryEq029PositiveAlphaBound as an independent source gate.
